title: A competitive coordination effect to simultaneously achieve high-energy and stable cycles in a Li-metal pouch cell at −40 °C
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9907-9916
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03522H, Paper
Xingxing Meng, Xiao Zhang, Litong Shi, Zhe Chen, Jiashen Meng, Feixiang Ding, Xiong Liu, Baokang Zhang, Qian Wang, Liqiang Mai, Chaojiang Niu
The competitive coordination between Li+ and dimethyl carbonate (DMC) and 1, 2-dimethoxyethane (DME) weakens the Li+-solvent interaction and forms a robust inorganic-rich interface, enabling stable cycling of Li-metal pouch cells at −40 °C.
